'''Rao Zihe''' ({{zh|饶子和}}, born September 1950) is a Chinese [[biophysics|biophysicist]] and former president of [[Nankai University]]. He is an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] and of [[The World Academy of Sciences]].

==Biography==
Rao was born in September 1950 in [[Nanjing]], [[Jiangsu]], and graduated from [[University of Science and Technology of China]] in 1977. He received his master's degree from [[University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences|Graduate School of Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 1982, and PhD in biophysics from [[University of Melbourne]] in 1989. He subsequently worked as a [[postdoctoral researcher]] in [[David Ian Stuart|David Stuart]] laboratory in [[Oxford University]]. In 1997, he returned to China and established the Structural Biology Laboratory in [[Tsinghua University]]. He became the director of [[Institute of Biophysics, Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 2003, and the president of [[Nankai University]] in 2006.<ref name=HLHL/>

Rao published the structure of a calcium binding human [[EGF-like domain|epidermal growth factor-like protein]], the first crystal structure in the EGF family, in 1995.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Rao |first1=Zihe |last2=Handford |first2=Penny |last3=Mayhew |first3=Mark |last4=Knott |first4=Vroni |last5=Brownlee |first5=George G. |last6=Stuart |first6=David |title=The structure of a Ca2+-binding epidermal growth factor-like domain: Its role in protein-protein interactions |journal=Cell |date=1995 |volume=82 |issue=1 |pages=131–141 |doi=10.1016/0092-8674(95)90059-4 |pmid=7606779 |s2cid=8741348 |doi-access=free }}</ref> During the [[SARS]] outbreak, Rao's laboratory solved the first crystal structure of a [[SARS coronavirus]] protein, the SARS-CoV Main Protease.<ref name=HLHL>{{cite web |title=Rao Zihe |url=http://www.hlhl.org.cn/english/showsub.asp?id=516 |publisher=HLHL Foundation |access-date=4 December 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite book |editor1-last=Lee |editor1-first=S.H. |title=SARS in China and Hong Kong |date=2006 |publisher=Novinka |location=New York |page=62 |chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=7YgpNtIL1VwC&q=rao+zihe+sars+structure+2003&pg=PA62 |access-date=4 December 2018 |chapter=The Advance of Research on SARS in China|isbn=9781594546785 }}</ref>

Rao was elected a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 2003, and a member of the [[Third World Academy of Sciences]] in 2004. Rao was also the president of Biophysics Society of China from 2006 to 2017.<ref>{{cite web |title=Professor Zihe Rao |url=https://www.journals.elsevier.com/journal-of-structural-biology/editorial-board/professor-zihe-rao |website=Journal of Structural Biology |publisher=Elsevier |access-date=4 December 2018}}</ref>
